goal: More verified work per frontier-model token without trading away required behavior or evidence fidelity.

experiments.baseline: Pinned baseline compiler, same current documentation corpus as candidate
experiments.candidate: Inventory-first shedding, current-state context last, assignment-appropriate builder brief
acceptance: Preserve governing instructions or explicitly disclose omission; omissions never waive requirements
Preserve verbatim relevant source excerpts
Do not prescribe task authoring for unrelated implementation assignments
Do not invent a mandatory separate reviewer or human handoff gate
experiments.quality_limit: Retention and instruction correctness are not coding-success parity. Smaller output alone is not acceptance.

experiments.baseline: Full existing outline JSON and default raw-source trace-reading guidance
experiments.candidate: Summary-first full-run metrics, followed by explicit inclusive logical step windows with original source coordinates
acceptance: All aggregate fields and file citations retain exact full-run values
Selected steps retain original source path, digest and source step ID across continuations
Missing and invalid ranges cannot appear as empty successful evidence
Unknown cost and unavailable sources stay unknown or unavailable
Unselected full JSON remains unchanged
Use paired task identities and count unsuccessful or missing model attempts
experiments.quality_limit: Local navigation probes are exploratory and not hermetic Harbor coding evaluations or proof across unseen tasks/models.

experiments.baseline: Pinned baseline implementation, same synthetic and real checkout corpus
experiments.candidate: Invocation-local test inventory and uncontaminated machine-readable output
acceptance: Preserve existing direct-reference impact semantics
Preserve child failure status
Emit a parseable single JSON document when JSON was requested
experiments.quality_limit: Less repeated local computation is not itself a measured reduction in model tokens. Direct-reference selection is not a complete dependency closure.

follow_up_experiments.why_now: The completed original navigation study preserved exact answers but bounded guidance increased command count. A deterministic six-source CLI check then established that first-error fusion preserves selected records and whole-run accounting while avoiding the summary-to-range round trip.
follow_up_experiments.selection: Use the same seed and frozen eligibility rules, but ranks 7 through 12 of the original hash-ranked distinct-native-head pool; do not consult reward, exception, verifier, or processed outcomes to select them.
follow_up_experiments.baseline: Full existing outline JSON, unchanged default readout
follow_up_experiments.candidate: One first-error readout, then the same raw-source access if needed; recommendations are not access restrictions
acceptance: Use the same six mechanical fact fields and frozen exact scorer as the first navigation study
Retain all planned failed, missing, timed-out, or quota-blocked attempts
Verify source hashes and code identity before admission
Keep repeats nested by native source and disclose repeated underlying benchmark tasks
follow_up_experiments.quality_limit: This compares full versus fused guidance on a new held-out source cohort. It does not causally estimate fused versus old summary-range guidance by subtracting results across different cohorts, and is not general coding-quality parity.

follow_up_experiments.why_now: Original cross-family probes exposed fenced JSON and overlength source-copy failures. Quote and reference protocol code has offline controls; tagged gateway source additionally shows response_format is parsed but not forwarded in the installed release. A separately logged two-call capability probe tests that boundary, not policy quality.
candidate_factors: Exact quote versus frozen visible source-fragment references
Plain text versus an explicitly requested terminal tool submission, with the unchanged strict answer and grounding scorer
follow_up_experiments.baseline: Original quote/text prompts and hidden keys remain byte-identical; preserve completed original results rather than regrade or repair them
follow_up_experiments.admission: Technical pilots first, maximum four calls each; then at most sixteen complete-pair calls per admitted protocol cell if route, quota, source, and parsing controls pass
follow_up_experiments.technical_admission_rule: Require valid source/runtime, quota, exact requested/self-reported route and wire request pins. Tool cells additionally require exact serialized single-call admission and SDK agreement. Do not condition admission on correct policy choices or grounding scores; those are measured quality outcomes and all remain in the denominator. Preserve failed technical pilots separately. No native-schema quality cell is admitted merely because an ignored request parameter was accepted.
follow_up_experiments.baseline_repeat_policy: Retain both completed original quote/text repeats and report their full denominators. New main cells have one repeat; comparisons are exploratory with repeats nested under four original contexts, not additional independent tasks.
acceptance: Unknown, duplicate, ambiguous, tampered, unseen, missing and refused references remain failures
No fence stripping, quote truncation, fallback request, or validator widening
Retain all failures and unknown usage
Native JSON-schema request parameters are not evidence of provider enforcement
follow_up_experiments.quality_limit: Small instruction/citation probes, not coding non-inferiority or independent-question sampling.

follow_up_experiments.why_now: The completed two-repeat coding study retained all six passes per arm but reduced reported input/output only 0.439% and increased uncached input 8.27%; the pilot-sized cost gain did not replicate. Test an independent requested-effort factor.
follow_up_experiments.baseline: Candidate compiler context with requested high reasoning effort
follow_up_experiments.candidate: The exact same candidate compiler context with requested medium reasoning effort
acceptance: Identical prompt and pack hashes across arms for each task
Fresh complete pinned baseline snapshots, opaque workspaces, unchanged source-only write scope and frozen external graders
Alternate first arm by original task and nested repeat
Same requested model and native binary; no runtime/model preference adoption
Included subscription only, reported weekly usage below 60 percent before each attempt; no native five-hour window is currently reported
Retain every planned failed, missing, timed-out or quota-blocked attempt and unknown usage; no attempted generation retries
Report total, cached and uncached input separately, plus output and actual behavioral/source-scope grades
follow_up_experiments.quality_limit: Three convenience problems with nested repeats, not independent new tasks or broad non-inferiority. Requested effort is not provider attestation; logical usage does not establish all physical upstream consumption or invoice cost.

follow_up_experiments.why_now: All 18 completed native coding attempts performed checks: 70 check-bearing command items among 224 command items. The common assignment did not explicitly delegate verification and asked for checks performed, so this is observed work and ambiguous ownership, not established violations or waste.
follow_up_experiments.baseline: Explicit primary implementation owner with focused self-verification
follow_up_experiments.candidate: Explicit background implementation worker; parent alone owns external verification
controls: Same candidate compiler pack and requested high effort
Same original public feature requests, complete baseline source, edit scopes, native model/binary and frozen external grader
Same explicit snapshot capabilities and compact-diagnostic instruction in both arms
Alternate first arm by original task
Included subscription only, reported weekly quota below 60 percent, no generation retry or default/runtime preference adoption
acceptance: Retain every planned failure, missing result, timeout and quota-blocked attempt
Report external behavioral/source-scope grades separately from instruction-compliance observations
Report total, cached and uncached input separately plus output and deduplicated command/check/patch operations
Preserve the original preparation manifest and grading contract; derive new owner prompts into separately pinned files
follow_up_experiments.quality_limit: Removing self-checks may remove useful correction. This three-task probe tests that tradeoff without assuming parity; equal observed grades are not broad non-inferiority and failed external grades remain failures.

follow_up_experiments.why_now: The original medium failures were test-generated out-of-scope data writes, while explicit edit-only parent verification passed the three original tasks. Test the composition without assuming effects add or subtract across studies.
follow_up_experiments.baseline: Candidate compiler with explicit edit-only parent verification and requested high effort
follow_up_experiments.candidate: Identical complete parent-verified prompts and candidate compiler with requested medium effort
controls: Both complete prompt byte strings match within each pair
Preserve the original source-only write scope and frozen external grader
All six failing-baseline and positive-patch controls passed before model admission
Fresh included-subscription quota admission and unchanged native runtime; no generation retries or default adoption
acceptance: Retain every planned failed, missing, timed-out and quota-blocked attempt
Keep instruction compliance separate from behavioral and source-scope acceptance
Report cached, noncached, output and total usage separately; fewer commands need not imply fewer tokens
Archive actual admitted runtime separately from subsequently safer preparation helpers
follow_up_experiments.quality_limit: Same three convenience problems and one repeat, not independent held-out tasks, an actual fallback cascade, broad quality parity or provider attestation.

analysis_rules: Pin source bytes with full SHA-256 digests, not generated structural repo-map digests
Counterbalance paired arm order deterministically and retain all raw attempts privately
Keep repeats nested under original task identity; do not fabricate independent bootstrap units
Normalize provider usage names explicitly; missing counters and monetary cost stay unknown
Report cache-read tokens separately and do not equate subscription usage or catalog prices with an invoice
Do not promote a context-size reduction into an unmeasured frontier-model quality claim
Archive raw private traces outside version control; commit only privacy-safe findings and reproducible code
